dossier_meta.paper: Polynomial bounds for chromatic number VII. Disjoint holes
dossier_meta.catalog_title: Open problem (poly-χ-bounded for k-multihole with only odd cycles)
dossier_meta.statement_text: For any integer $k \geq 1$, is the class of graphs with no $k$-multihole in which all the cycles have odd length polynomially $\chi$-bounded?
dossier_meta.context_text: This class is $\chi$-bounded [9], but it contains the class of $\{P_5, C_5\}$-free graphs. The authors state they cannot yet prove it is poly-$\chi$-bounded, referring to [15] for the best current bounds.
